plan-review.yaml coach step with blocks must be extended to pass hierarchy_incomplete and hierarchy_incomplete_detail from precheck outputs for ctx.inputs consumption

finalize_verdict and drift_floor verdict recomputation must emit INDETERMINATE verdict when hierarchy_incomplete flag is set, with no carve-out for relevance since container-criteria suppression makes trigger condition unstatable
